Writing to you and myself, 

No sympathy to anyone haven't cleared .
No 'sab acha hoga' 
No ' better luck next time' 
No 'be more focused' 
No 'December is your attempt'
We are not weak , we are the strongest ! 

Coming soon :)
comment: Failure in competitive exams often tests recovery more than preparation. The ability to reassess strategy, protect confidence, and return stronger is what separates long-term performers.
